final:
The default cache folder is no longer worked out when Playwright loads, so setting `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` (to `0` or to a folder) now avoids the "Unsupported platform" error on Termux. I haven't built or run anything.

- **`packages/playwright-core/src/server/registry/index.ts`**: `defaultCacheDirectory` and `defaultRegistryDirectory` were constants evaluated at import. They are now functions. `registryDirectory` only calls `defaultRegistryDirectory()` when the variable isn't set.
- **`packages/playwright-core/src/serverRegistry.ts`**: it had the same eager lookup, so its default cache and registry directories are now functions too. They are only called when `PWTEST_SERVER_REGISTRY` isn't set.
- **`packages/playwright-core/src/tools/mcp/browserFactory.ts`**: updated the one caller to `defaultCacheDirectory()`.

The error is still thrown when the default folder is actually needed on an unsupported platform, such as when the variable isn't set.
